```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(warn = 1)
```

## Load experiment object

```{r}
library(jaxExperiment)

expt_file = file.path("outputs", "experiment.rds")
expt = load_experiment(expt_file)
expt
```

## Volcano plots (saved to PNG)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
spec5 = stage5_spec_default()
expt = stage5_write_volcano_plots(expt, spec = spec5)
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3.2}
rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
if (nrow(rep5$volcano_files) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(rep5$volcano_files$file)
}
```

## Enrichment (goseq) plots (saved to PNG)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
expt = stage5_run_goseq(expt, spec = spec5)
expt = stage5_write_goseq_plots(expt, spec = spec5)
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
if (nrow(rep5$goseq_files) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(rep5$goseq_files$file)
}
```

## Summaries

```{r}
rep5 = stage5_report(expt)
knitr::kable(rep5$enrichment_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Save experiment object (for later stages)

```{r}
save_experiment(expt, expt_file)
```

```{r}
gc()
sessionInfo()
```
